Pepper Turkey Skillet
for 4 servings
2 tablespoons oil
1 red bell pepper, sliced
1 yellow bell pepper, sliced
1 large red onion, sliced
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon pepper
2 pounds ground turkey
Preparation
Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the peppers and onion until soft.
Add the turkey and cook until browned.
